item.name: GET users - status, array, and first user name

exec: pm.test("Public API HTTP status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Public API response is an array", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("First user name is Leanne Graham", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0].name).to.eql("Leanne Graham"); });
